ze.antwortFrist: Respond before the day changes to {datum}. If unanswered, the promise expires under the existing rules.
ze.warum: Fulfilling, postponing or breaking a promise affects support and credibility. The response cards show immediate effects and deadlines remaining afterwards.
ze.veraltet: This reminder is obsolete or the promise has already been closed. Nothing will be charged again.
ze.vertroestenText: The deadline moves to 90 days from today. Support falls; the promise remains binding.
ze.brechenText: The promise is explicitly abandoned. This costs more loyalty than letting a reminder expire unanswered.
ze.akut: After this response, the weakest active chair has loyalty {n}, below 20. Unless support improves sufficiently by the monthly review on {datum}, {sitze} government seats are at risk; {rest} would remain. Other monthly effects can change support.
ze.weitereFrist: Address another reminder before the day changes to {datum}. This conditional calculation deducts nothing today and does not project other monthly effects.
